messages.author: 74f2e6fef4c447fd
messages.subject: Point process models for spatiotemporal distance sampling data
parts:
Hi all,

Just read a great paper, "Point process models for spatiotemporal distance sampling data" by Yuan et al. I would like to do something similar with bird data.  I wrote the lead author for the code but haven't heard back.  I know several other authors on the paper are part of this discussion group.  Any chance you all have a copy of the code and would be willing to share?

Thanks in advance,

Tim Meehan

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Point process models for spatiotemporal distance sampling data
parts:
Hi,
I'm one of the project leaders on that paper...

The code for the paper isn't useful to share, since it used an obsolete development version of the package we're developing for these types of problems.
The package is still in development, but at your own risk you can take a look. ;-)
I'll send a separate email with more info (we'll make a public announcement when due to have more widespread testing).

Finn
